people.name: Tej Shah
people.expertise: High-end bungalows, luxury residential detailing, and corporate office buildings.
people.bio: Before founding Nirmal Studio, I worked at R+R Architects in Ahmedabad. Today the studio designs high-end bungalows, luxury residential interiors, and corporate office buildings — each one built around how light moves through a room, how a family actually lives in a home, and what the site itself is already telling us. Materials that age honestly. Climate and context respected, not overridden. Vastu treated as a real constraint, not an afterthought. That’s the practice I run, one project at a time.
